subject.title: chore(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 14 updates

question: After all coupled immutable-pin assertions are repaired, do the applicable workflow and security owners approve this grouped set of third-party action revisions for privileged automation?
rationale: Source inspection can confirm official repositories and deterministic guard defects, but it cannot substitute for repository-owner acceptance of new executable revisions that receive tokens, secrets, publishing access, and scanning permissions.

options.title: Repair and owner-review
options.body: Synchronize every stale assertion, complete exact-head workflow checks, and obtain applicable workflow and security owner approval before merge.

options.title: Replace the bot branch
options.body: Create a stable maintainer-controlled grouped update if Dependabot rebases continue discarding the coupled assertion repairs.

recommendation.title: Repair and owner-review
recommendation.body: Synchronize every stale assertion, complete exact-head workflow checks, and obtain applicable workflow and security owner approval before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The current immutable-pin guards and affected token assertions trace directly to this person's merged workflow work, providing the strongest available routing signal.
